# ScanMySaaS

> ScanMySaaS is a browser-based website vulnerability scanner for SaaS founders, developers, and small product teams. It crawls a public web application, runs 60+ automated security checks, and returns a prioritized report with severity, affected URLs, and finding descriptions.

## Platform facts

- One free scan with no credit card required.
- Each scan can crawl up to 25 reachable pages on a website the user owns or is authorized to test.
- Checks cover SSL and HTTPS behavior, security headers, cookies and forms, exposed files, client-side patterns, CORS, redirects, DNS and email-security signals, and other publicly observable risks.
- The free public GitHub repository scanner reads a bounded set of security-relevant text files from one pinned commit of the default branch, or of a branch, tag or commit given in the URL, and checks for committed environment files, credential patterns, unsafe GitHub Actions, client-side secret exposure, Supabase RLS signals, wildcard CORS, unsafe code sinks, and public source-map settings.
- Repository scans do not clone a repository, install packages, run builds, execute code, or reveal matched secret values. Anonymous public scans are returned to the browser and not saved; signed-in scans run in the background and are saved privately to the account.
- Findings can be copied as technical prompts for Codex, Claude, Cursor, or another coding agent. Prompts require the agent to verify the signal, make a minimal fix, add regression tests, avoid exposing secrets, and report residual risk.
- Private GitHub repositories can be connected on Starter and Pro through a read-only GitHub App (contents and metadata read). Files are processed in memory and discarded; reports are saved privately to the account. The scanner does not search full Git history.
- New scans also report a SaaS readiness snapshot for TLS certificate trust and expiry, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, llms.txt, security.txt, canonical URL, and homepage indexability. These readiness signals do not change the security score.
- Free reports include a security score, severity breakdown, affected URLs, finding descriptions, and one prioritized remediation when an actionable finding is available.
- Paid plans unlock remediation for the remaining findings, configuration examples, monthly credits, saved scan history, rescans, and score trends.
- Starter is $29 per month for 10 monthly scan credits. Pro is $79 per month for 30 monthly scan credits. Current plan details are maintained on the pricing page.
- ScanMySaaS is an automated outside-in check, not a penetration test, security certification, or substitute for professional review.

- [GitHub secret scanning for vibe-coded apps](https://www.scanmysaas.com/guides/github-secret-scanning-for-vibe-coded-apps) — Response and prevention for committed credentials.
- [GitHub Actions security for vibe-coded apps](https://www.scanmysaas.com/guides/github-actions-security-for-vibe-coded-apps) — Workflow permissions, pull request boundaries, and immutable action references.
- [Supabase security for vibe-coded apps](https://www.scanmysaas.com/guides/supabase-security-for-vibe-coded-apps) — RLS, key placement, tenant policies, storage, and server authorization.

## Company and safe use

ScanMySaaS is operated by Content Petit LLC. Only scan websites you own or have explicit permission to test. Support: stefan@scanmysaas.com.

Last updated: August 13, 2026

## Paid-plan AI logic review

Starter and Pro repository scans can send selected source file contents, paths and line numbers to OpenAI, an AI-analysis subprocessor, using the Responses API with store: false. This disables response storage, not all provider retention. Users can opt out for future scans in the dashboard or repository picker. AI findings have source=ai, confidence, code references, and a Needs verification label; they are not proven vulnerabilities. Low-confidence findings do not affect the score. All unverified AI findings combined can lower the rule-based score by at most 20 points. Per-scan and monthly token budgets apply, with a higher monthly allowance on Pro. Unavailable, timed-out or over-budget AI review does not prevent a rule-based report. Free users keep rule findings and an honest paid-feature teaser, not AI finding details.

Website scan reports are private to the owner or anonymous creator browser. Owners may create, replace or revoke a random sharing link. Report IDs alone do not grant public access, including older reports. Repository reports remain account-private.
